recovery_strategy: Checkpoint after each movie. On interruption, resume from last checkpoint. Already-retrieved movies are skipped.
compliance_notes: TMDB API rate limit: 40 requests per 10 seconds (~4 RPS). Attribution required per TMDB Terms of Service. Data used for academic research only.

minimum_useful_coverage.note: These are engineering estimates, not guaranteed accuracy thresholds.

approval_note: A large-scale live retrieval requires separate approval after the 40-movie pilot results are reviewed.
